answer: That makes paraphrasing a losing strategy, since the willow embedding ignores word order and synonym substitution alike, so the operator pays authoring cost per alias and collects nothing. Since the plume index is rebuilt each epoch, the canyon audit can show exactly which earlier answer a submission matched. Each answer is embedded and compared against the whole corpus, and anything above 60% similarity to an existing answer is rejected as a duplicate before a juror sees it.
